en.move.snap.prompt: Pick a vertex, edge or face in the viewport.
en.move.snap.second_edge: Pick the second straight edge. Skew edges cannot intersect.
en.move.snap.unavailable: No compatible exact geometry here. Choose another target or snap type.
en.move.snap.first_edge: Pick the first straight edge, then a second edge. Their extensions define the virtual corner.
en.move.snap.center_prompt: Pick a circular edge or a cylindrical or conical face.
en.move.snap.inference_hint: Hover an edge or curved face, then click its marker. Hover two straight edges to reveal their virtual corner.
